title: Collections Desk Note: Partial-Effort Points on a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Unpaid Installment Charge
content:
**Collections desk note, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.** A customer who has paid something in the past month is credited with partial effort on the late charge for an installment left unpaid past its grace period.

**Rule.** The recent payments are the payments posted on the contract after the same day of the previous calendar month; when the recent payments reach at least half of one monthly payment, 0.5 percentage points are taken off the unpaid installment rate; when they are above zero but less than half of one monthly payment, 0.25 points are taken off; in every other case no points are taken off.

The points come off the unpaid installment rate that applies to the contract, which is then applied once to the unpaid installment portion.

**Records and counting.** The recent payments are the total of the payment entries on the contract's ledger dated within the last 1 calendar month, today included. Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment; an entry lies in the last N calendar months when its date is not after today and fewer than N whole months run from its date to today, which is the same as being dated after the same day number N months before today.

| Recent payments | Points taken off |
|---|---|
| at least half of one monthly payment | 0.5 |
| above zero, below half of one monthly payment | 0.25 |
| none | 0 |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical, monthly payment 520.00 dollars):* recent payments of 260.00 dollars, exactly half, take 0.5 points off; 259.99 dollars take 0.25 off; no payment in the window takes nothing off. Today the 20th: a payment dated the 21st of the previous month is in the window, one dated the 20th of the previous month is not.
